item.description: YETI takes a serious step into technical hiking gear with the Skala Hiking Pack, a new backpack line designed to deliver comfort, support and fast access for everything from day hikes to multi day trips. Available in four sizes ranging from 32 to 60 liters, the Skala aims to provide a more tailored fit for different body types while bringing the brand?s rugged reputation into the world of performance backpacking. item.title: FLINT AND TINDER JAPANESE SELVEDGE RESERVE
item.description: Flint and Tinder looks east for its latest denim release, introducing the Japanese Selvedge Reserve as part of its small batch Japan Reserve Capsule. item.title: WINGCUBE FOLDING TENT BOX
item.description: Wingcube Folding Tent Box is a bold new concept that reimagines what a compact camper can be. Designed as a tall, narrow cube that rides on top of a separate trailer, it expands at camp into a mushroom shaped platform tent with two raised bedrooms and a central outdoor living zone. The idea is simple but clever: tow a compact box that is easy to maneuver, then unfold it in minutes into a space that feels far larger than its footprint.
